summary.name: SWE-bench Official Leaderboards
summary.one_liner: SWE-bench's official leaderboard site, which ranks AI models and agents by the percentage of real GitHub issues they resolve in Python repositories.
use_cases: Compare AI coding models on resolving real GitHub issues
Check which coding agent currently leads SWE-bench
Find open-weights models that perform well on software engineering tasks
Research evaluation methods for LM coding agents
Train or evaluate your own software engineering agent
summary.what_it_does: The page is the official leaderboard hub for the SWE-bench family of benchmarks. Each entry reports % Resolved, the share of task instances an agent or model solved. The main SWE-bench set has 2294 instances drawn from 12 Python repositories, and a Verified view with 500 instances is run in the same mini-SWE-agent environment for every model. Entries are marked when they are open-weights models and when the run was performed or directly checked by the SWE-bench team. The page also keeps a dated news list covering releases such as SWE-bench Lite, Multimodal, Verified, Docker-ized evaluation, SWE-agent, SWE-smith, CodeClash and ProgramBench.
notable: Verified view runs every model in the same mini-SWE-agent environment for a fair comparison
Marks open-weights models and runs checked directly by the SWE-bench team
Includes 2294-instance full benchmark and 500-instance Verified subset
Related projects listed include SWE-agent, mini-SWE-agent, SWE-smith, CodeClash and ProgramBench
caveats: Performance varies with the model used by the agent, so scores reflect the model-agent pairing
Benchmark covers only real GitHub issues from 12 Python repositories for the full set
